command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P5-bl-local-symbol.s -o out.o && ld.lld --image-base=0 -Ttext=0 -o out.elf out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.elf out.bin
notes: Input: `start: bl next / next: bl start`, linked at 0. `llvm-mc` alone does not resolve the two branches (it emits a `fixup_aarch64_pcrel_call26` and zero bytes), so the bytes are taken after `ld.lld` has resolved them: +4 -> imm26=1, -4 -> imm26=0x3ffffff. The plan resolves the same displacements itself with `pcrel_begin` + `scale` shift 2.
